claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
The 2026 Oscars will air on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 2026 Oscars will air at 7 p.m. ET / 4 p.m. PT.
The 2026 Oscars will be broadcast on ABC.
Hulu is the official streaming home of the 98th Academy Awards.
Hulu offers the live show including ad-supported plans.
YouTube TV offers free trials to watch for free.
FuboTV offers free trials to watch for free.
DirecTV offers free trials to watch for free.
The ABC app/Website is available to stream by logging in with a cable provider or participating live TV service.
Red Carpet Coverage starts at 3:30 p.m. ET / 12:30 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu.
Yahoo Entertainment will provide red carpet updates.
